meta.title: Roles
meta.description: Give people roles on Friends of Animals, and take them away.

adminRoles.title: Roles
adminRoles.lead: Find a person, then give them a role or take one away. A change counts from their next page, and the audit log keeps a record of it.

search.title: Find a person
search.label: Name or email address
search.hint: Part of their name, or the start of their email address: at least 2 letters.
search.none: Nobody's name or email address matches “{query}”.

user.title: Roles of {name}
user.notFound: We couldn't find that person. Their account may have been deleted. Search again.
user.none: {name} has no roles. Everyone who is signed in can use the member pages.

grantForm.title: Give a role
grantForm.scopeIdHint: Paste its id. Leave this empty when the role applies everywhere.

alerts.scope_not_allowed: That role can't apply there. For example, an institution coordinator is always for one institution, and a super admin is always everywhere.
alerts.last_super_admin: This is the last super admin. Give someone else super admin first, so that someone can always manage roles.
alerts.not_found: We couldn't find that person. Their account may have been deleted. Search again.
alerts.forbidden: Only a super admin can give or remove roles.

done.granted: Role given. It counts from their next page.
done.revoked: Role removed. It stops counting from their next page.
done.unchanged: Nothing changed: they already had that role, or had already lost it.
